description: Search US lobbying disclosures and foreign-agent registrations via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search US lobbying disclosures and foreign-agent registrations via MCP.
interface.longDescription: Explore federal lobbying disclosures from the US Senate Office of Public Records and foreign-agent registrations from the US Department of Justice. These primary sources connect lobbying activity, registrants, clients, and foreign principals through a read-only MCP interface.
